not.tr: Bulut kalın ama ışık yine de geçiyor. Zor olan o.
not.en: The cloud is thick, yet the light still comes through. That is the hard part.
not.fr: Le nuage est épais, la lumière passe quand même. C’est là le difficile.

kaynak_kredisi: George Inness, “Twilight in Italy”, 1890 · Art Institute of Chicago, kamu malı
